# Issues
When submitting an issue, please check:
1. The issue frequently/constantly occurs
   - This means, if the issue doesn't occur 100% of the time or frequently occurs with a pattern, please don't make an issue.
2. The issue is an issue on our part
   - If you are having an issue, ensure you have correctly configured the library. For example,
   - the .build.gradle.kts is properly configured (or any other build file),
   - the settings.gradle.kts is properly configured (or any other settings file),
   - you have used the .setApiKey() and .setCookie() methods
3. You have viable proof (preferably image or video, and any exceptions you encounter) of the issue
   
If your issue fits all of the requirements, you are more than welcome to create an issue.

# Pull Requests
**Bugs:** If you have a pull requests that fixes a bug or security issue, please feel free to fork and PR.
**Improvements:** Always feel free to make a PR that enhances this library!
